definitions.explanation: Plants cultivated for food or commercial purposes. A general term covering rice, vegetables, fruits, grains, and other farm products.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}で{農作物|のうさくぶつ}に{被害|ひがい}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: Crops were damaged by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: この{地域|ちいき}の{主|おも}な{農作物|のうさくぶつ}は{米|こめ}と{大豆|だいず}だ。
examples.english: The main crops of this region are rice and soybeans.

examples.japanese: {気候変動|きこうへんどう}の{影響|えいきょう}で、{世界中|せかいじゅう}の{農作物|のうさくぶつ}の{収穫量|しゅうかくりょう}が{減少|げんしょう}している。
examples.english: Due to climate change, crop yields around the world are declining.

notes:
USAGE:
{農作物|のうさくぶつ} is a formal compound of {農|のう} (agriculture) and {作物|さくぶつ} (produce, crops). It is commonly used in news, academic, and agricultural contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {農作物|のうさくぶつ}を{育|そだ}てる (to grow crops)
- {農作物|のうさくぶつ}の{被害|ひがい} (crop damage)
- {農作物|のうさくぶつ}の{収穫|しゅうかく} (crop harvest)
- {主要|しゅよう}{農作物|のうさくぶつ} (major crops)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {農作物|のうさくぶつ}: crops, agricultural produce (formal, comprehensive)
- {作物|さくもつ}: crops (shorter, also common)
- {農産物|のうさんぶつ}: agricultural products (includes processed goods)
